scope: All fixed branches and all mechanically matched spelling pairs. No fitting, text validation, morphological correctness, holdout, or causal/circuit claim. Writers have unit full-U norm; real-token centering changes no pair differences. Pair-energy ratios are descriptive, not fractions of full tensor energy or probabilities. Standalone parent banks must not be summed as a whole-graph replacement because shared-pair terms would be double-counted.
